name: utc-calendar-age
test: does not warn until a date is more than thirty calendar days old

name: terminal-newline
test: counts a terminal newline as the end of line one hundred fifty

name: fence-opener
test: ignores code fences and indented code when checking links

name: fence-closer
find: if (marker && marker[1][0] === fence[0] && marker[1].length >= fence.length && !marker[2].trim()) fence = undefined;
test: checks real links following a closed fence

name: indented-code
test: ignores code fences and indented code when checking links

name: inline-code
test: ignores link syntax inside inline code

name: pipe-in-code
test: accepts a backticked pipe inside a fact cell

name: escaped-pipe
test: accepts escaped pipes and multiple-backtick code spans

name: leading-pipe

name: trailing-pipe
test: accepts the unchanged valid fixture without warnings

name: register-presence
find: if (section < 0) { failures.push(`${FACTS}: no 'The register' section.`); return; }
test: rejects a missing register table or a changed register header

name: register-end
test: stops the register at the next section even without a blank line

name: header-section-boundary
test: does not borrow a register table from a later section

name: register-header
find: failures.push(`${FACTS}: the register needs its four-column header and separator.`);
test: rejects a missing register table or a changed register header

name: separator-validation
test: rejects a missing table separator

name: table-end
test: leaves a table after the register to its own section

name: short-row
find: if (cells.length !== 4) { failures.push(`${at}: a register row must have 4 cells, found ${cells.length}.`); continue; }
test: rejects a three-cell fact row instead of silently dropping it

name: extra-cell
find: if (cells.length !== 4) { failures.push(`${at}: a register row must have 4 cells, found ${cells.length}.`); continue; }
test: rejects a fifth fact cell instead of discarding its evidence

name: real-calendar-date
test: rejects an observation date that overflows February

name: finite-calendar-date
test: rejects an impossible observation date

name: observation-date
find: if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) failures.push(`${at}: the Observed cell is not a real YYYY-MM-DD date.`);
test: rejects a non-ISO observation date

name: source-required
find: if (/^(?:TODO|-)?$/iu.test(source.replace(/[`*_]/gu, '').trim())) failures.push(`${at}: no source. A placeholder is not evidence.`);

name: dash-source
